title: Stress: LiDAR outliers in an empty room
description: Nothing within 4 m between 0.6 and 2.1 m. 1 % depth noise plus 0.02 % of pixels replaced by random medium-confidence ranges (a synthetic artifact model, not measured iPhone behaviour). Any phantom pin here comes from a single stray sample. Each sector reports its third-nearest confident point and the sector filter steadies bands between frames, so stray pixels raise nothing.
